thread:
jade: Client Lodestar asks for a short POC plan: which catalog models to use, rough pricing, and security checklist. EOD tomorrow.

client_pm: Use case = support triage + automated summaries. Volume ~12rps, avg session ~1800 tokens, want P95 <220ms. Data includes order IDs + occasional SSNs -> needs redaction + KMS.

omar: Quick take: offer two variants — open-13b-fp16 for low-latency hosted route, and open-13b-quant-4bit for cost-directed batch processing. Recommend KV cache on repeated convo turns.

nora: KMS + redaction flagged. We support AWS and GCP KMS with envelope encryption. Will prepare a 1-page security summary (SOC2, KMS flow, retention, logs). Any residency constraints?

client_pm: US-only for keys and logs. SOC2 required. Response SLA: 4hr initial.

lee: Infra note: to hit P95 <220ms at 12rps/1.8k tokens we must keep low-latency route batch sizes <=4. That ups cost. Dedicated pool helps if they want guarantee; hosted okay for pilot. VPC adds 2-3wk setup.

omar: Pilot config sketch:
```
routes:
  - low_latency: open-13b-fp16, batch=4, max_seq=2048
  - bulk: open-13b-quant-4bit, batch=28, kv_cache=true
policy: fallback_to_quant_on_saturation
cost_note: "rough: $3.1/token-unit fp16, $0.85/token-unit quant"
```

jade: Action items before EOD:
- omar: pricing triad (trial, monthly commit, 12mo commit) + pilot timeline
- nora: security one-pager + questionnaire answers (KMS residency note)
- lee: infra checklist for hosted -> dedicated/VPC transition
- jade: compile single PDF and send to client
